figures.finding: Sierra Leone reports its age of majority as eighteen.
figures.applies: Sierra Leone; the State's 2025 report (the Child Rights Act 2007 defines a child as under 18).

sources.said: The age of majority in Sierra Leone is 18 years.

figures.finding: Sierra Leone reports a Minimum Age for Work Declaration of fifteen for non-hazardous work and eighteen for hazardous work, with the Employment Act 2023 (Part X) on children's hazardous work.

sources.said: Minimum Age for Work Declaration: 15 years for non-hazardous work, 18 years for hazardous work
